title: G11: execute and fix-round prompts tell the worker to commit on its branch and name the real gate script (.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh), so Codex runs stop ending with uncommitted work
spec:
Observed on goal/T-0260: three Codex runs (T-0267, T-0276 and the first T-0242 thread in Phase F) finished with all their work uncommitted, and every Codex final message mentions that 'scripts/tests_green.sh' is absent. The execute prompt (.orchestrator/prompts/execute.md, rendered by spawn.render with the packet since G2) says 'Implement this single task in the current worktree, then run scripts/tests_green.sh' and never says to commit; fix-delta.md has the same two problems. The daemon's gate then holds the task for a dirty worktree or the Planner has to spawn a second thread just to commit.
Change: execute.md and fix-delta.md instruct: run `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh .` from the worktree until it exits 0 (failures-only output on red), then `git add -A && git commit` on the current branch with a message that starts with the task id, and finish with a final message stating the gate result, the commit sha and the failures-only output (empty when green); never leave uncommitted changes; never touch files outside scope. Tests: tests/test_spawn.py::test_execute_prompt_names_gate_and_commit and ::test_fix_delta_prompt_names_gate_and_commit assert the rendered prompts contain '.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh' and 'git commit' and do not contain 'scripts/tests_green.sh'.
acceptance: Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

result.summary: Codex (luna) committed 23606ac in wt/T-0324: execute.md and fix-delta.md now name .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh and instruct git add -A and commit with the task id; no stale scripts/tests_green.sh reference remains. Gate red on tests/test_executor.py::test_fallback_claude_when_codex_cooling, which asserted the old 'tests_green' wording. Fix round T-0328 (b12190e) updates the assertion.
result.reason: gate_red: test_executor.test_fallback_claude_when_codex_cooling pins the old prompt wording
